translation.name: In yancuic mononotzalistli ica Totecohtzin Jesucristo

book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: IN YANCUIC TLAHTOLI ICA JESUCRISTO QUEN OQUIHCUILUI IN TETIOTLATITLANIL MATEO

content: In tlalnamictilistli ica in mosihuautilistli
In Jesús oc sepa oquinnonotzaloc ica in tlalnamictilisten huan oquiniluiloc:
―Ocachi nanquinehnehuilisque ica in tetlatequiutilistzin Dios tla nanquicaquihque quen oquichiu se hueyixtoc. Oquichiu se iluitl ihcuac omosihuauti in itelpoch.
Oquintitlan in tlaquehualten mayacan quinnotzacan in tetlatlautilten, huan yehhuan ahmo oquinejque yasque.

Oc sepa oquintitlan oc sequin tlaquehualten huan oquiniluic: “Xiquiniluican in tetlatlautilten yica tlachihchiutli in tlacuali. Yonitlatequiuti maquinmictican in cuacuehten huan oc sequin tlatomahualten, huan nochin yica in tlacuali. Mahualacan ipan in mosihuautilistli.”
Huan in tetlatlautilten ahmo oquichiuque cuenta. Seya oya tequiti imila, huan oc seya oya ica itlaseman.
Huan in oc sequinten oquinquitzquihque in itlaquehualuan in hueyixtoc huan oquinuihhuitejque huan oquinmictihque.
Oncan in hueyixtoc tequin ocualan huan oncan oquintitlan in soldados maquinmictican inon temictiyanimen huan maquitlatican inaltepeu.
Oncan oquiniluic in itlaquehualuan: “Nochin yica in tlacuali ica in mosihuautilistli, huan inon tetlatlautilten ahmo quinamiqui mahualacan tleca tequin ahmo cualten.
Mayacan ipan ohtli huan xiquintlatlautican nochin aquin nanquinahsisque mahualacan ica in mosihuautilistli.”
Oncan in tlaquehualten oyahque ohohtli huan oquinnechicohque san aquin oquiahsique, cualten huan masque ahmo cualten. Huan ijcon ipan in cali otemohuac ica tlacamen.
’Oncan in hueyixtoc oya tlahtec quinita in itetlatlautiluan. Huan oquitac se tlacatl ompa, ahmo tlaquentihtoc quen nochin oc sequinten ica in tlaquemitl den mosihuautilistli.
Huan in hueyixtoc oquitlahtlani: “Tlacatzintli, ¿quenin otiquixcohyehui ticalaquis nica huan ahmo titlaquentihtoc quen in oc sequinten?” Huan yehhua ahmo tlen onahuat.
Oncan in hueyixtoc oquiniluic in aquin tetlahtlamacanimen: “Xiquilpican icxihuan huan imahuan huan xictohuetzocan quiahuac ipan tlayohuilotl, campa nochin tzahtzisque huan hasta tlantzahtzisque.”
Tleca miyacten omonechicohque, huan san quesqui tlapehpenilten.
In tlahtoli ica in renta
Oncan oyahque in fariseos huan omononotzque quen teichtacaahsisque ica in Jesús, huan ijcon cuali teteluisque.

Yeh in ica oquintitlanque sequin aquin inuan mosechiutoque, san secnin ihuan sequin aquin ihuan pohuihque in Herodes. Yehhuan oteiluihque in Jesús: ―Tlamachtiyani, ticmatihque mach mihtohua tlen melahuac, huan monextiliyahque in tlen melahuac ica in Dios. Ahmo ticchihua cuenta tlen iquisca niyan se tlacatl, in tla hueyi noso ahmo.
¿Tlen ticnehnehuiliya? ¿Cuali in tla tictlaxtlahualisque in renta in hueyixtoc César noso ahmo?
Huan Jesús omonehnehuili quen oquinequiyayahque teichtacaahsisque, huan oquiniluiloc: ―Namehhuan san ome namoxayac. ¿Tleca nannechpihpiyahque?
Xinechnextilican in tomin ica tlen quitlaxtlahuahque in renta. Huan otehualiquilihque in tomin.
Ic omotac Jesús, omotlahtlanihque: ―¿De aquin ixayac quipiya inin tomin, huan aquin yehhua itoca tlahcuilohtoc nica?
Otenanquilihque: ―Yeh in ixayac huan itoca in hueyixtoc. Oncan Jesús omoluihque: ―In tlen ihuaxca in hueyixtoc, xicmacacan, huan ahmo xiquilcahuacan in tlen nanmotemactisque ica in Dios.
Ihcuac oquicajque inon, san quen tel oquimatque huan otecauteuque.
In tlahtoli ica in ihxohualistli
Saniman inon tonali oyahque teita in Jesús sequin saduceos. Yehhuan quiluiyahque mach ahmo ihsasque in mijcamen. Huan ic inon otetlahtlanihque ica inon tlahtoli. Huan oteiluihque:

―Tlamachtiyani, in Moisés oquihto mach in tla miquis se tlacatl sihuahua, huan ahmo oquipix niyan se iconeu, oncan iicniu quipiya tlen ihuan motlalis ihuehpol huan quinitasque impiluan huan quihtosque ipiluan aquin omic.
Ica tehhuan ocatcahque chicome icnimen. Omosihuauti in tetiachicau huan omic. Huan quen ahmo oquipix niyan se iconeu, oncan in sihuatl ihuan omotlali in icniu icuitlapa in inamic.
Huan ijcon oquipanoc ica yehhua, huan noyojqui ica nochin chicome. Niyan seya ahmo oquipix iconeu.
Huan satepa no omic in sihuatl.
Oncan tel, ihcuac ihsas den mijcamen, ¿aquin yehhua in isihuau de inon chicome icnimen, quen inuan omotlali nochten?
Huan Jesús oquinnanquililoc: ―Namehhuan nanmotlapolochtiyahque, tleca ahmo nanquinehnehuiliyahque tlen quihtohua ipan in Itlahcuiloltzin, niyan in tlen cuali mochihua in Dios.
Huan queman ihsasque in mijcamen, ayacmo mosihuautisque tleca ayacmo aquin miquis huan ayacmo aquin tlacatis. Mochihuasque quen in ángeles den Dios tlen caten in neluicac.
¿Tlahmo nanquiamapoutoque ipan in Itlahcuiloltzin in tlen omihto Yehhuatzin Dios ica in ihxohualistli?
Ijcon omihto: “Nehhuatl niDios aquin temahuestiliyahque in Abraham huan Isaac huan Jacob.” In mijqui ahhuel temahuestiliya in Dios huan in aquin yolticaten, queme.
Huan ic oquicajque in tlen omihto, quen tel oquimatque ica tlen oquinnextililoc.
In tlen ocachi hueyi ica tetlanahuatil in Dios
Ihcuac in fariseos oquicajque mach in Jesús oquintentzacualoc in saduceos, oc sepa omopachohque tenahuac.
Huan sequin de yehhuan tlamachtiyanimen den itlanahuatil Moisés. Huan seya oquinequiyaya teichtacaahsis in Jesús, huan otetlahtlani:
―Tlamachtiyani, ¿cahtli yeh in tetlanahuatil ocachi hueyi?
Huan Jesús omoluic: ―“Xitetlasohtla Totecohtzin Dios ica nochin moyolo, huan ica nochin monemilis, huan ica nochin motlanehnehuilis.”
Yeh in achto tetlanahuatil huan yehhua ocachi hueyi.
Huan ic ome ixnesi in tlen achto tlanahuatili, huan quihtohua: “Xictlasohtla motlacaicniu quenin tehhua timotlasohtla.”
Inon ome tetlanahuatil quen ipehualoca de nochin itlanahuatil Moisés huan in tlen oquinextilihque in tlayolchicaucamen.
¿Aquin ichichicaixuiu in Cristo?
In fariseos ayamo otecauteuque,
huan Jesús oquintlahtlaniloc: ―¿Tlen nanquinehnehuiliyahque ica in Cristo? ¿De aquin ichichicaixuiu? Huan oteiluihque: ―Yehhua ichichicaixuiu in David, in aquin ocatca hueyixtoc yihuehcau.
Oncan in Jesús oquintlahtlaniloc: ―Huan tla ijcon melahuac, ¿tleca inon David otenotz iteco? Huan quen oquiyolchicau in Itiotonaltzin Dios, ijquin oquihcuilo in David:

content.text: In Totecohtzin Dios omoluic Notecohtzin Cristo:

content: Tel, ¿quen cuali yes in Cristo ichichicaixuiu in David, huan in David, yehhua tenotza Itecohtzin? Quihtosnequi in Cristo ocachi hueyi iquisca quen in hueyixtoc David.
Huan niyan aquin ahhuel otenanquili niyan se tlahtoli, huan de inon tonali niyan aquin oixcohyeu ic tetlahtlanis ocachi.
